document_name: Speed WMS Loading Data Model — Chargements

CHG_DAT.description: Loading header — groups orders for physical loading onto a vehicle/carrier

columns.name: CHG_CODE
columns.description: Loading code — part of composite business key

columns.name: CHG_DATE
columns.description: Loading date — part of composite business key

CHL_DAT.description: Loading lines — individual orders included in a loading

loading_header_to_lines.description: Get loading with all its order lines
loading_header_to_lines.example_sql: SELECT chg.CHG_CODE, chg.CHG_DATE, chl.OPE_NOOE FROM CHG_DAT chg INNER JOIN CHL_DAT chl ON chg.CHG_CODE = chl.CHG_CODE AND chg.CHG_DATE = chl.CHG_DATE WHERE chg.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chg.CHG_CODE = :CHG_CODE

loading_lines_to_orders.description: Get the orders included in a loading
loading_lines_to_orders.example_sql: SELECT chl.CHG_CODE, chl.CHG_DATE, ope.OPE_NOOE, ope.OPE_STAT, ope.TIE_CODE FROM CHL_DAT chl INNER JOIN OPE_DAT ope ON chl.ACT_CODE = ope.ACT_CODE AND chl.OPE_NOOE = ope.OPE_NOOE WHERE chl.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chl.CHG_CODE = :CHG_CODE

loading_lines_to_mission_lines.description: Link loading lines to mission pick lines
loading_lines_to_mission_lines.example_sql: SELECT chl.CHG_CODE, mil.MIE_NOMI, mil.OPE_NOOE, mil.MIL_STAT FROM CHL_DAT chl INNER JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON chl.ACT_CODE = mil.ACT_CODE AND chl.OPE_NOOE = mil.OPE_NOOE WHERE chl.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chl.CHG_CODE = :CHG_CODE

loading_lines_to_expedition_support.description: Link loading lines to expedition support units
loading_lines_to_expedition_support.note: SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT instead of ACT_CODE — critical exception

order_lines_to_mission_lines.description: Link order lines to mission pick lines in loading context

mission_lines_to_expedition_support.description: Link mission lines to expedition supports in loading context

expedition_support_to_movement.description: Get stock exit movements for expedition supports
expedition_support_to_movement.note: TMV_CODE = 40010 or 40110 for definitive stock exit

movement_to_stock.description: Link movement to its stock record
movement_to_stock.example_sql: SELECT sex.SEX_SUPE, mvt.TMV_CODE, stk.ART_CODE, stk.EMP_LIEU FROM SEX_DAT sex INNER JOIN MVT_DAT mvt ON sex.SEX_ACT = mvt.ACT_CODE AND sex.SEX_SUPE = mvt.MVT_NOSU INNER JOIN STK_DAT stk ON mvt.STK_KEYU = stk.STK_KEYU WHERE sex.SEX_ACT = :ACT_CODE AND mvt.TMV_CODE IN ('40010','40110')

check_loading_details.description: Check full loading details for a specific order
check_loading_details.example_sql: SELECT * FROM CHG_DAT chg INNER JOIN CHL_DAT chl ON chg.CHG_KEYU = chl.CHG_KEYU WHERE chg.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chg.OPE_NOOE = :OPE_NOOE;

query.sql: SELECT * FROM CHG_DAT chg INNER JOIN CHL_DAT chl ON chg.CHG_KEYU = chl.CHG_KEYU WHERE chg.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chg.OPE_NOOE = :OPE_NOOE;

procedures.business_logic: Retrieves shipment loading details for a specific order.

procedures.procedure_name: Get All Orders in a Loading

query.sql: SELECT chg.CHG_CODE, chg.CHG_DATE, chl.OPE_NOOE, ope.OPE_STAT FROM CHG_DAT chg INNER JOIN CHL_DAT chl ON chg.CHG_CODE = chl.CHG_CODE AND chg.CHG_DATE = chl.CHG_DATE INNER JOIN OPE_DAT ope ON chl.ACT_CODE = ope.ACT_CODE AND chl.OPE_NOOE = ope.OPE_NOOE WHERE chg.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND chg.CHG_CODE = :CHG_CODE ORDER BY chl.OPE_NOOE;

procedures.business_logic: Get all orders included in a loading with their current status.

TMV_CODE_loading.description: Movement type codes relevant to loading on MVT_DAT

values.40110: Definitive stock exit from prepared stock

safety_rules: NEVER join MIE_DAT and SEX_DAT directly using OPE_NOOE — MIE_NOOE must NOT be used for this join
NEVER join MIE_DAT with OPE_DAT or CHL_DAT using order number directly — route through MIL_DAT instead
Loading header composite key: ACT_CODE + CHG_CODE + CHG_DATE
Loading line composite key: ACT_CODE + CHG_CODE + CHG_DATE + OPE_NOOE
SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT not ACT_CODE — always check this when joining to SEX_DAT
Always execute SELECT before UPDATE operations
Do not execute UPDATE in production without approval
